newsitem.title: USA: One Price Clothing Q4 same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: One Price Clothing Q4 same-store sales up.

text.p: One Price Clothing Stores Inc said Tuesday that fourth-quarter sales for the 13 weeks ended February 1 totalled $71.3 million, compared with $74.2 million for the 14 weeks ended February 3, 1996.
Excluding the additional week in last year's quarter, sales increased four percent.
One Price had 43 fewer stores in operation at the end of fiscal 1996 than at the end of fiscal 1995.

Comparable-store sales rose five percent in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996 (adjusted for the calendar shift - to compare the 13 weeks ended February 1, 1997, to the 13 weeks ended February 3, 1996).
Total average store sales increased 10 percent for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996. The company had 645 stores in operation at the end of the fourth quarter and fiscal year ended February 1, 1997.
